item.title: Pezeshkian: Gas Exporting Countries Forum summit was constructive and fruitful
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkianprior to his departure from Russia, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, commented on his two-day visit to the country, stating: "During the 8th Summit of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF), extensive and in-depth discussions and interactions took place. We reached positive understandings, and the summit proved to be both constructive and fruitful."

item.title: Araghchi congratulates Lula da Silva on his victory in Brazilian election
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Abbas Araghchi, the Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran, in a telephone conversation on Tuesday evening with Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, congratulated the incumbent president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, on his victory in Brazil’s 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Iranian Ambassador’s response to US representative: Speak based on facts, not fabricated accusations
item.description: New York, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations Gholamhossein Darzi speaking at the end of the UN Security Council meeting on Iran, in response to the claims made by US representative Mike Waltz, [the Iranian representative] displayed images of those martyred in acts of aggression by the United States and the Zionist regime against Iran, stating: "Let us speak based on facts, not on fabricated accusations."

item.title: IRGC dismantles two terrorist teams in southeast Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has dismantled two terrorist teams and arrested their members in the southeastern cities of Saravan and Iranshahr, foiling planned attacks, the IRGC Ground Force’s Quds Headquarters said on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran to UNSC: Israel possesses nuclear weapons, yet you are concerned about absence of inspectors in Iran!
item.description: New York, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations Gholamhossein Darzi has criticized the silence of the Western members of the UN Security Council regarding the crimes committed by the US and Israel against Iran, saying that the International Atomic Energy Agency is not a tool for extracting concessions or advancing geopolitical agendas while wondering Israel possesses nuclear weapons, the UNSC is concerned about the absence of inspectors in Iran!

item.title: Pezeshkian says US military intervention in Persian Gulf disrupts global energy markets
item.description: Moscow, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian says that US military intervention in the Persian Gulf is disrupting global energy pricing, supply and transit, warning that its consequences extended far beyond regional countries and threatened international energy security and economic growth.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86305178/Pezeshkian-says-US-military-intervention-in-Persian-Gulf-disrupts

Moscow, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian says that US military intervention in the Persian Gulf is disrupting global energy pricing, supply and transit, warning that its consequences extended far beyond regional countries and threatened international energy security and economic growth.
